title: Lost update in wallet top-ups
root_cause: Lost update from SELECT-then-UPDATE race: deposit/withdraw both read balance then write balance +/- amount computed from the stale read. Two concurrent txns read the same old balance (e.g., both read 100), then each writes old +/- amount, so one overwrites the other (both write 200 instead of 300). The second UPDATE blocks on the first's row lock but still uses its stale read, so committed balances fall short of the sum of successful ops.
fix: Replaced read-modify-write (SELECT then UPDATE with client-computed value) with single atomic UPDATE statements: deposit uses UPDATE ... SET balance = balance + %s; withdraw uses conditional UPDATE ... SET balance = balance - %s WHERE balance >= %s and distinguishes unknown-account vs InsufficientFunds with a follow-up SELECT only on failure. The atomic UPDATE holds the row lock while computing, so concurrent increments/decrements serialize correctly without extra locking.

repro_report.example_violation: lost update: account 1 balance is 107700 but 80 successful deposits of 100 from 100000 should give 108000
